faqs: What file formats do you support?
Text, PDF, DOCX, images (JPG, PNG), audio (MP3, WAV, M4A) and video (MP4, MOV). 20+ formats in total.
Around 97% on clear input, with legal terminology handled carefully. Always have important filings reviewed by a qualified translator.
Files are encrypted in transit and at rest, and are never used to train models. We follow the DPDP Act.
